repos_data.description: Curated list of awesome tools, demos, docs for ChatGPT and GPT-3

A Chrome extension enhancing privacy in OpenAI's ChatGPT client.  🛡️  Enables users to easily hide and unhide chat history 🛡️  Operating directly in-browser without accessing or storing chat data. 🛡️  Ideal for maintaining privacy during screen shares  🛡️  Contributions are welcome!

Real-time system audio translation for macOS — translate any audio (YouTube, podcasts, meetings) live on screen with OpenAI or Google Gemini. On-device speech recognition; optional low-latency realtime mode.
OpenAI, GPT 5.6, GPT-Image-2, Whisper API clients for Go
